mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.audit_log (occurred_at, employee_id, action, object_type, object_id, description, ip_address, changes, request_id, source) VALUES (now(), (SELECT id FROM app.employee WHERE keycloak_id = CAST(#{keycloakId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)), #{action}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{description}, #{ipAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{changesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source})
